newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom drives NZ share market to new 2-12 yr high.
newsitem.headline: Telecom drives NZ share market to new 2-12 yr high.

text.p: * NZ share market sets new 2-1/2 yr highs
* Telecom surges to new all-time highs, hits $7.00
* Fletcher results mixed but overall seen positive ---------------------------(Aug 28)-----------------------------
Price movements at close
LAST CHG
329 +1 * NZSC cap index -10.96 at 4,463.05
380 -2 * Volume NZ$66 million. Futures +15 at 1,137
699 +14 * Other movers - +21 +10
Heavy buying in leading stock Telecom thrust the New Zealand share market on Wednesday to new 30 month highs.
Telecom surged to a new high of $7.00, ending 14 cents up at NZ$6.99.
The top 40 index ended 21.43 points up at 2,240.49 on healthy volume of $66.1 million.
Brokers said the mood of the market was buoyant and they see further gains in the wind.
"There is a very good underlying tone out there. It's not bond market driven and it's encouraging. I think there is still a bit more upside to come," said JB Were broker Luke Koekoek.
"There was still unsatisfied buying at the close," he said.
Apart from the hefty rise by Telecom, the result of the Fletcher Challenge group of companies was the day's highlight.
Brokers said the letter stocks results were mixed, with Fletcher Paper disappointing, but overall they were more positive than negative.
Fletcher Energy gained nine cents to $3.40 on reports of better than expected gas flows from its Brunei wells.
Fletcher Paper came in below expectations with its profit but brokers said the EBIT line was not as bad as first thought and it bounced off its lows to end down six at $2.80.
Although further tough times are seen ahead for the pulp and paper industry, the stock may recover, brokers said.
Of the other leaders, Lion Nathan fell two cents to $3.80, continuing to react to news that it is reported to have lost market share in Australia to Fosters.
Tranz Rail closed 21 cents up at $6.95 after a strong surge in the U.S. but brokers noted it was on very light volume.
